Top Stories.headline: India demolishes security barricades outside Pakistan High Commission in tit-for-tat action
Top Stories.summary: Indian authorities removed 'unauthorised' structures and bollards outside the Pakistan High Commission in New Delhi using bulldozers on Wednesday, mirroring Pakistan's recent action against the Indian mission in Islamabad. The move came hours after Pakistan pulled down similar barricades outside the Indian HC.
Top Stories.why_it_matters: A reciprocal demolition of security infrastructure between two High Commissions escalates the diplomatic chill — every consular service at both missions is now effectively operating with reduced protection.

Top Stories.headline: Sensex rallies 500-600 pts, Nifty reclaims 24,200 as Trump delays Canada tariff, oil eases
Top Stories.summary: Indian markets opened sharply higher with Sensex jumping over 500 points and Nifty reclaiming the 24,200 mark, tracking a global relief rally after Trump said the US had 'a deal' with Canada and paused a 50% tariff for three days. IT and banking stocks led gains; rupee opened 19 paise stronger at 95.56.
Top Stories.why_it_matters: A 500-point Sensex rally driven by external cues (US-Canada de-escalation, crude pulling back from $92) shows Indian markets are again pricing global risk-on rather than domestic signals — a fragile dependency.

Top Stories.why_it_matters: A six-CM Zonal Council is the highest-level inter-state forum this year — items on water and IT will set the policy agenda for south India for the rest of 2026.

Top Stories.headline: Cabinet clears four railway multitracking projects worth Rs 13,041 cr; network to grow by 410 km

Top Stories.why_it_matters: A bulk Cabinet clearance of multitracking projects is unusual — it signals a backlog clearance push ahead of the state-election cycle and a Chennai MRTS merger that finally ends a 15-year bureaucratic limbo.

Top Stories.headline: Two Mumbai Parsi doctors to receive Pakistan's Nishan-e-Imtiaz for keeping Jinnah's illness secret
